info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Architecture Lookup API
info.description: The Enterprise Architecture Lookup API facilitates access to essential business direction data within enterprise systems. It provides insights into the structural and strategic components of an organization's architecture, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions. Typical consumers of this API include business analysts, system architects, and product managers seeking to analyze or align their initiatives with core business objectives. The service empowers organizations to understand and optimize their enterprise architecture framework effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the detailed information regarding the enterprise architecture, thereby facilitating better decision-making and strategic alignment within the organization.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the enterprise architecture details related to business direction. It must contain the relevant identifiers and parameters necessary for fetching the correct data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the enterprise architecture data.

GetEnterpriseArchitectureRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to enterprise architecture in the context of business direction operations.
